paper.title: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents
paper.central_claim: 提出统一开源框架 ClawGUI（ClawGUI-RL 在线 RL 基础设施[模拟器+真机]、ClawGUI-Eval 标准化评测流水线、ClawGUI-Agent 真机部署）；在该流水线内端到端训练的 ClawGUI-2B 在 MobileWorld GUI-Only 上 SR 17.1%（同规模 MAI-UI-2B 11.1%）；ClawGUI-Eval 对已发表基线复现率 95.8%。（子主张按各自类型评价：RL 部分≈component_training，Eval 部分≈evaluation_resource。）

evidence.quote: When a container is detected as unhealthy, the system automatically draws from the queue and rotates to a healthy replacement
evidence.support_explanation: 环境管理器的健康检查/备用服务器轮换机制

evidence.support_explanation: 真机训练仅靠 MLLM judge 作奖励，无系统级校验

evidence.quote: For PRM-based step-level reward judgment, we employ Qwen3.5-72B as the judge model.

evidence.quote: We adopt the GiGPO algorithm with a rollout group size of 8, sampling temperature of 0.7, and learning rate of 1e-6 for 3 epochs with a training batch size of 8.

gap.author_gap: 三缺口：开源在线 RL 基础设施缺失、GUI 基准数字不可比、训练出的 agent 难到达真实用户（E001-E003）。
gap.checked_gap: 缺口1（RL 基础设施闭源）有最近邻佐证：UI-TARS-2 已有统一沙箱/异步 rollout 平台但未释出（E032）；缺口2（评测漂移）的存在性本文并未单独实验量化——仅间接由复现表中 2 处不一致体现（E034/E035）；缺口3（部署）为产品/工程缺口，无度量。

MAI-UI / MobileGUI-RL / ComputerRL / UI-Venus-1.5（正文引述，未取得全文）

lineage.closest_adjacent: UI-TARS-2 的沙箱+多轮 RL 栈（版本 2509.02544，material_id 同）；本文贡献在“开源+真机+评测/部署打包”，不是新算法。

gap.residue: 开源可复现的 GUI 在线 RL 管线仍稀缺；真机在线 RL 的可行性与收益仍无公开证据（本文亦未给出结果）。
gap.stakes: 无法外部复现 → 在线 RL 增益无法独立验证；评测漂移可达“几个点”→ 小幅提升难分辨。
gap.method_response: 提供环境管理器+PRM/GiGPO+评测流水线+部署代理；对 gap1 给出可运行基础设施（但开源完整性无法由全文核验），对 gap2 给出配置钉死与预测公开，对 gap3 给出系统描述。
gap.remaining_gap: 真机训练实效、PRM 的有效性与可靠性、训练/评测任务隔离、与其他开源 RL 栈的并列对比、部署层的任何用户侧评测。
unresolved: “first open-source”“none release infra”仅凭本文引述，无法由固定原文核验（ComputerRL 等未取得全文）。

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: RS C26 的“把单一终端标量重粒度化为步级信号”↔ K19 的“PRM 步分作稠密奖励”；两者都由外部 judge 提供信号。

expectations.text: Report execution-checked success rate on OSWorld (or OSWorld-Verified) for desktop computer-use claims, stating the step budget (15 vs 50 steps) and observation setting
expectations.applies_when: an empirical claim that a method improves end-to-end task success of a desktop (Ubuntu/Windows) computer-use agent
expectations.reason: 无桌面 OSWorld 主张；GUI-only 评测限于 MobileWorld（移动）。

expectations.text: Report online success on AndroidWorld for mobile-agent claims, not only offline AndroidControl/AITW step metrics
expectations.applies_when: an empirical claim that a method improves task success of an Android/mobile GUI agent
expectations.reason: 改用在线交互基准 MobileWorld GUI-Only（117 任务）而非 AndroidWorld；有在线成功率，但无 AndroidWorld 对照，也未报告 AndroidControl 离线数。

expectations.text: Report success on WebArena (self-hosted, functional-correctness checkers) for web-agent training or planning claims; if the 165-task WebArena-Lite or a per-template subset is used, say so and justify it
expectations.applies_when: an empirical claim that a training, data-synthesis or planning method improves a web agent on self-hosted sites
expectations.reason: 无 Web agent 主张。

expectations.text: Evaluate live-web agents on Online-Mind2Web (human-validated, start URL given, no search engine) or Mind2Web-Live rather than only WebVoyager, where a naive search-and-click agent already solves 51% of sampled tasks
expectations.applies_when: a claim about web-agent success on real, live websites
expectations.reason: 无实时网页主张。

expectations.text: Report GUI grounding on ScreenSpot-Pro (high-resolution professional desktop) and ScreenSpot-v2, not only ScreenSpot v1, which saturates (7B and 72B indistinguishable)
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a model or data recipe improves screenshot-to-coordinate GUI grounding
expectations.reason: 无“提升 grounding 的模型/数据配方”主张——ClawGUI-Eval 复现的是他人模型的 SS-Pro/SS-V2 数值。

expectations.text: Compare a new grounder against UGround(-V1-7B), Aguvis-7B/72B, OS-Atlas-7B and UI-TARS(-1.5) at matched backbone size
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a grounding model or grounding-data recipe beats prior GUI grounders
expectations.reason: 未提出新 grounder。

expectations.text: Compare a native end-to-end GUI policy against UI-TARS(-1.5)-7B (or the same backbone's SFT-only model) and against an agentic framework (GPT-4o/o3 planner + specialised grounder such as UGround, Aria-UI, Jedi, GTA1)
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a trained end-to-end GUI agent model improves online task success
expectations.reason: 训练后的端到端 2B 与同基座 MAI-UI-2B 及表内未训练模型比较；未与 UI-TARS-1.5 同规模、同基座 SFT-only 控制对比；表中 Doubao-1.5-UI-TARS(26.3)、MAI-UI-8B(19.7)与 agentic 框架均更高（作者已承认 agentic 属另一机制）。

expectations.text: For planner-grounder systems, hold the planner fixed and swap grounders (e.g. GPT-4o + UGround vs + Aguvis vs + Jedi), and report the planner alone
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a grounding component (or the planner-grounder split itself) improves agent task success
expectations.reason: 未做 planner-grounder 拆分主张。

expectations.text: Compare GUI online-RL methods against DigiRL, WebRL, filtered BC / AWR and an SFT-only model trained on the same data
expectations.applies_when: a claim that an RL algorithm (online, offline-to-online, semi-online or model-based) improves a GUI/web agent
expectations.reason: 仅 GRPO vs GiGPO 的内部对比；无 SFT-only(同数据)、DigiRL/WebRL/Filtered-BC/AWR 对照。

expectations.text: Validate an LLM/VLM success judge or outcome reward model against human labels on trajectories from agents not used to build it (agreement/accuracy, plus the resulting success-rate gap)
expectations.applies_when: a method that uses an LLM/VLM judge, ORM or reflector to label trajectory success for evaluation, filtering or reward
expectations.reason: MLLM-as-judge 同时用于真机奖励与 PRM；全文未报告与人工标签的一致率或在未参与构建的 agent 轨迹上的校验。

expectations.text: Report judge reliability separately for positive and negative verdicts (precision and NPV, or precision/recall per class), not only overall accuracy
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a GUI-agent judge, PRM or ORM is reliable enough to serve as reward or evaluator
expectations.reason: 无 judge 的正/负判决分别的可靠性（precision/NPV）报告。

expectations.text: When a learned judge or PRM is the RL reward, show downstream policy gain against an alternative reward (rule/script checker, ORM vs PRM, another judge), and address reward hacking or bias
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a learned reward model or verifier improves GUI-agent RL training
expectations.reason: PRM 作为 RL 奖励：无 PRM on/off 或与规则奖励的下游增益对比；无奖励投机分析。Table 2 比较的是优势估计算法，不是奖励来源。

expectations.text: Measure execution checkers (evaluation scripts) two-sidedly: false negatives on alternative valid solutions as well as false positives
expectations.applies_when: a benchmark, synthetic environment or RL pipeline whose reward comes from per-task execution checkers or evaluator scripts
expectations.reason: 奖励来自 MobileWorld 的特权状态检查；本文未度量检查器假阴性/假阳性（沿用基准，且 MLLM judge 叠加）。

expectations.text: For PRMs or step-level verifiers, ablate the label source (human vs GPT-4o-generated step labels)
expectations.applies_when: a claim that a process reward model for GUI steps improves RL or best-of-N
expectations.reason: 无 PRM 标签来源消融（人工 vs 模型生成）；PRM 为零样本 72B。

expectations.text: Do not rest an agent capability claim on offline step accuracy (AndroidControl, Multimodal-Mind2Web, GUI Odyssey) alone; add an online benchmark or show the offline metric predicts online success
expectations.applies_when: a claim of improved agent capability measured with offline, teacher-forced step metrics

X.reason: 环境生命周期与训练超参给出（E004、E009），评测三段式给出（E022）；但 PRM 的输入输出格式/分值合成、训练任务集（来源、规模、与评测隔离）、真机任务集、混合 CLI-GUI 的路由规则、记忆写入/淘汰条件均未给出（E033）。主要步骤有描述，关键条件不清。=2。
